production_change: NONE. R54 60-point cap and MEC R3 stay Production; promotion needs a separate explicit Owner approval.

candidates.hypothesis: With the same frozen prediction, KRS and MEC output and the same selection order as the R54 cap, a smaller point limit (C05 / C10 / C20 / C30) reaches a PFS at least as high as Control R54-60 with less stake.
candidates.change: ticket selection only (point limit); no prediction change
candidates.scope: formal LOCAL races with a settled result
candidates.population: same races, same Signed FINAL, same payouts; 100-yen flat stakes so equal points = equal budget
candidates.reject_if: at 100R the candidate PFS is below Control, or its top-1 race supplies >= 40% of its payout
candidates.promote_if: at 100R PFS >= Control + 10 points with top-1 share < 40%, re-confirmed at 300R; then an Owner decision

candidates.hypothesis: Revision 2 from the T-10 check (material change only) predicts and pays at least as well as the superseded Revision 1 on the same race.
candidates.scope: races with a Revision 2 Signed FINAL
candidates.control: Revision 1 tickets and ranking of the same race
candidates.primary_metric: winner rank and PFS, Revision 2 vs Revision 1
candidates.reject_if: at 30 revised races Revision 2 is worse on both winner rank and PFS (report to the Owner)
candidates.promote_if: not applicable; report the measured effect
